How to Read The Deal

Every spoken line runs three scores in real time. Watch all three simultaneously.

PROFIT is leverage. Who controls the frame, the price, the information. Profit moves before either person speaks — in the posture, the timing, the choice of first word.

LOVE is relationship capital. On the street it is trust, loyalty, and reputation. It accumulates slowly and burns in seconds. Most people don't realize they're spending it until the account is empty.

TAX is the real cost behind every transaction. Exposure. Risk. The debt that doesn't appear on any receipt. The Tax always comes due.

INTENT What the speaker actually wanted — not what they said.

BODY Posture, movement, gaze, pause. The signal under the words.

PRESSURE The need or risk driving the line. Who feels it and how hard.

Read the lesson. Then read the conversation again.

CHAPTER ONE

First Contact

The first thirty seconds decide everything.

◆◆◆◇◇ Advanced

New Face on the Block

He walked up without a voucher.

ROME the seller. reads faces for a living. · DARIUS first time. trying not to show it.

OPENING

ROME P 74 —— L 60 —— T 26 —— 67.6 PLT —DARIUS —— 36 P —— 50 L —— 34 T — PLT 37.6

Rome clocked three tells before Darius finished his first sentence.

DARIUS Yo. You holding?

SMALL TAX

ROME P 72 —— L 50 —— T 36 +2 54.4 PLT ▼DARIUS +2 38 P +2 52 L -2 30 T ▲ PLT 42

INTENT Find out if this is the right spot without committing to anything.

BODY Hands in pockets. Looking slightly past Rome instead of at him.

PRESSURE Darius has been standing on the corner for eleven minutes building courage.

The pause between words. First tell.

ROME Depends who's asking.

ROME P 80 +8 L 62 +2 T 24 -2 72.8 PLT ▲DARIUS -4 34 P -2 50 L +4 34 T ▼ PLT 36.8

BODY Doesn't look up from his phone. Completely unbothered.

ROME P 38 +4 L 54 +4 T 30 -4 40.8 PLT ▲DARIUS -6 74 P —— 62 L -2 22 T ▼ PLT 65.6

BODY Eyes come up. First real eye contact.

ROME P 40 +4 L 52 -2 T 32 +2 39.2 PLT ▲DARIUS +2 90 P +2 66 L -2 18 T ▲ PLT 80.4

◆◆◆◆◇ Elite

The Test Buy

He was sent to evaluate. Rome already knows.

OPENING

ROME P 78 —— L 62 —— T 24 —— 71.6 PLT —RICKY —— 68 P —— 54 L —— 30 T — PLT 60.4

Ricky's job is to not look like Ricky's job.

ROME P 72 —— L 56 —— T 32 +2 60.8 PLT ▼RICKY +2 80 P +2 64 L -2 22 T ▲ PLT 72.8

BODY Too relaxed for a first visit. Nobody relaxes this fast.

PRESSURE Ricky has done this forty times for different organizations.

The compliment before the product. Second tell.

ROME Who sent you.

PROFIT TICK

ROME P 82 +4 L 64 +2 T 22 -2 74.8 PLT ▲RICKY -4 68 P -2 52 L +4 36 T ▼ PLT 57.6

INTENT Get the name before any product moves.

BODY Looks up from the phone this time. Steady.

PRESSURE Rome felt the prepared relaxation. Nobody is that easy on a first visit.

PROFIT MOVE +4. Skip the compliment. Go to the source.

RICKY My man Tommy from the Sixth told me to come through.

PROFIT TICK

ROME P 78 +6 L 66 +2 T 20 -2 72 PLT ▲RICKY +2 70 P +4 56 L -4 32 T ▲ PLT 60.4

BODY Eye contact when he says Tommy.

PRESSURE Ricky decided on the walk over that the name was safer than the lie.

ROME P 86 +4 L 70 +4 T 18 -2 79.2 PLT ▲RICKY +4 74 P +4 60 L -4 28 T ▲ PLT 64

INTENT Acknowledge the introduction is valid while signaling who Rome actually wants to meet.

BODY Slight smile on "himself."

PRESSURE Rome just sent a message to Tommy through a man Tommy sent to evaluate him.

PROFIT SNATCHED +4. Elevated the conversation to the right level while completing the transaction.

FINAL SCORE

ROME P 86 —— L 70 —— T 18 —— 79.2 PLT —RICKY —— 74 P —— 60 L —— 28 T — PLT 64

ROME 79.2 ◆◆◆◆ Positioned RICKY 64 ◆◆◆ Mission complete

◆◆◆◆◆ Legendary

The Undercover Setup

He smells wrong. Can't prove it.

KENNY the seller. instincts are running hot. · AGENT undercover. very good. almost perfect.

OPENING

KENNY P 64 —— L 56 —— T 34 —— 56.8 PLT —AGENT —— 74 P —— 50 L —— 28 T — PLT 66

The most dangerous opening in the book.

AGENT Yo what's good. My cousin said you're the one to see.

PROFIT TICK

KENNY P 66 +2 L 58 +2 T 32 -2 59.2 PLT ▲AGENT -2 72 P -2 48 L +2 30 T ▼ PLT 63.6

INTENT Use a vague referral that can't be confirmed or denied.

BODY Voice and body relaxed. Almost too aligned.

PRESSURE Agent knows that mismatched eye contact is what burns covers fastest.

The cousin move. Softer than a named voucher, harder to verify.

KENNY What cousin.

SMALL TAX

KENNY P 64 -2 L 58 —— T 36 +4 57.6 PLT ▼AGENT +2 74 P +2 52 L -2 28 T ▲ PLT 66.4

INTENT Force specificity on the referral before anything moves.

BODY Doesn't step back. Holds the ground.

PRESSURE Kenny knows that real vouchers come with real names.

PROFIT TICK. One question that requires a real answer or exposes everything.

AGENT Marcus. He stay on Clement.

PROFIT DIP

KENNY P 62 -2 L 56 -2 T 38 +2 55.2 PLT ▼AGENT +2 76 P +2 54 L -2 26 T ▲ PLT 67.6

INTENT Manufacture enough detail to fill the gap without making it verifiable.

BODY Slight pause before "Clement." Half a second.

PRESSURE The pause. Kenny clocked it.

Added a street — more specific than planned.

KENNY Marcus moves around. He don't have a set spot.

PROFIT TICK

KENNY P 66 +4 L 58 +2 T 34 -4 58.4 PLT ▲AGENT -4 72 P -4 50 L +4 32 T ▼ PLT 61.2

INTENT Name the inconsistency without making the accusation.

BODY Hands stay loose. Voice stays flat.

PRESSURE Kenny just told the agent he knows the answer was wrong without saying that.

PROFIT MOVE. True statement that names the flaw in the agent's answer.

KENNY I'm good today. You feel me.

PROFIT MOVE

KENNY P 76 +10 L 60 +2 T 28 -6 67.6 PLT ▲AGENT -8 68 P -6 44 L +6 38 T ▼ PLT 52.8

INTENT Remove yourself from the situation. No engagement, no evidence.

BODY Already half-turned when he says it.

PRESSURE Kenny needed this conversation to end. It just did.

PROFIT SNATCHED +10. Clean exit with no accusation and no evidence.

FINAL SCORE

KENNY P 76 —— L 60 —— T 28 —— 67.6 PLT —AGENT —— 68 P —— 44 L —— 38 T — PLT 52.8

KENNY 67.6 ◆◆◆ Walked away clean AGENT 52.8 ◆◆ Shut down

LESSON "I'm good today" with no accusation and no explanation is always cleaner than "I know what you are." The exit with no evidence is the win.

The Drought Conversation

He's the last one running. Everybody knows it.

◆◆◇◇◇ Intermediate

When She Comes to the Corner

First time a woman approaches. He assumes wrong.

OPENING

TY P 66 —— L 58 —— T 28 —— 58.8 PLT —KEONNA —— 60 P —— 62 L —— 26 T — PLT 57.6

The assumption costs Ty 4 Love before a word about product.

LOVE DIP

INTENT Establish control by questioning her presence.

BODY Arms cross. Eyes go up and down once.

PRESSURE Ty has never had a woman walk up to this corner. He defaulted to the wrong pattern.

TY P 64 +2 L 58 +4 T 28 -2 58.4 PLT ▲KEONNA +2 66 P +2 66 L -2 22 T ▲ PLT 61.2

BODY Even. Unbothered.

TY My bad. I don't get many—

KEEPING LOVE

TY P 66 +2 L 62 +4 T 26 -2 60.8 PLT ▲KEONNA +2 68 P +2 68 L -2 20 T ▲ PLT 62.8

BODY Drops arms. Smaller.

TY P 70 —— L 66 —— T 22 —— 64.4 PLT —KEONNA —— 70 P —— 70 L —— 18 T — PLT 64.4

CHAPTER TWO

The Price

Every number is a position. Every position is a bet.

◆◆◆◇◇ Advanced

The First Negotiation

He knows the price. She doesn't know he knows.

FLEX the distributor. set the price this morning. · VIC the buyer. thinks she can move it.

OPENING

FLEX P 80 —— L 64 —— T 22 —— 72.8 PLT —VIC —— 62 P —— 60 L —— 32 T — PLT 56.8

Vic did her homework. Flex doesn't know that yet.

VIC What's the number.

PROFIT TICK

FLEX P 64 +2 L 62 +2 T 30 -2 58.4 PLT ▲VIC +2 82 P +2 66 L -2 20 T ▲ PLT 74.8

INTENT Get the number before committing any position.

BODY Arms loose. Voice even.

PRESSURE Vic decided on the drive over: no small talk.

PROFIT TICK. Four words. Got straight to it.

FLEX Forty-five.

HOLDING

FLEX P 82 —— L 66 —— T 20 —— 74.8 PLT —VIC -2 62 P -2 60 L +2 32 T ▼ PLT 55.2

BODY Doesn't explain it.

◆◆◆◇◇ Advanced

The Front Request

He needs product on credit. He's been here before.

◆◆◆◇◇ Advanced

The Price Cut Request

The Bad Batch
